# anchors-project

A synthetic two-service project used by the `graveyard` CLI tests.

- The two lockfiles in this directory are hand-written. Package names and versions are real and equal to the anchor fixtures in `core/scoring/tests/fixtures/anchors/`. The relationships (`express` -> `node-uuid`, `request` -> `uuid`, and the dev/runtime split) are chosen to exercise exposure; they are not the packages' real dependencies. Nothing was installed or generated by a tool.
- The SBOMs in `../sboms/` are **real Syft 1.56.0 output** for these two directories (see "SBOM provenance").

## Layout

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `web/package-lock.json` | npm lockfile v3: `express`, `left-pad`, `moment` (runtime), `request` (dev), `node-uuid`, `uuid` |
| `api/uv.lock` | uv lockfile: `pycrypto`, `six` (runtime), `nose` (dev) |
| `../sboms/web.cdx.json` | Syft's CycloneDX 1.7 document for `web` |
| `../sboms/api.cdx.json` | Syft's CycloneDX 1.7 document for `api` |

## SBOM provenance

| | |
|---|---|
| Tool | Syft 1.56.0 (`syft --version` printed `syft 1.56.0`), the release the CLI pins |
| Date | 11 Nov 2026 |
| Commands | from `backend/cli/tests/fixtures`: `SYFT_CHECK_FOR_APP_UPDATE=false SYFT_JAVASCRIPT_INCLUDE_DEV_DEPENDENCIES=true ~/.local/bin/syft "dir:$PWD/anchors-project/web" -q -o cyclonedx-json > sboms/web.cdx.json`, and the same with `api` |
| Variables | `SYFT_JAVASCRIPT_INCLUDE_DEV_DEPENDENCIES=true` is what the CLI sets (`cli/syft.py`, CLI-DEV-1). Without it Syft omits the `dev: true` packages `request` and `uuid` from `web` |
| Edit | exactly one exact-string replacement per file: `metadata.component.name` (Syft writes the absolute path of the scanned directory) became `fixtures/web` or `fixtures/api`. Nothing else was edited, and the output is Syft's own compact one-line JSON. a search for the home-directory prefix finds nothing in either file (`test_no_fixture_contains_an_absolute_path`) |
| Replaces | the hand-written, Syft-shaped documents of T3. They assumed an edge from the project root to each dev direct dependency, which the real Syft does not write. A combined `all.cdx.json` is gone with them |

What the real documents contain (and why the CLI augments them, `docs/SPIKES.md` Q7):

- `web`: library components `anchors-web` (the project), `express`, `left-pad`, `moment`, `node-uuid`, `request`, `uuid`. The root `anchors-web` depends on `express`, `left-pad`, `moment`; `express` depends on `node-uuid`; `request` depends on `uuid`. **Nothing depends on `request`**, so `core.graph` finds two roots and drops `request`.
- `api`: `anchors-api` (the project), `nose`, `pycrypto`, `six`. The root depends on `pycrypto` and `six`. **Nothing depends on `nose`**, so it is listed but unreachable.

`cli/augment.py` adds `anchors-web -> request` and `anchors-api -> nose` from the lockfiles' declared direct dependencies before the graph is built. `test_augment_fixtures.py` checks both the raw and the augmented documents.

To regenerate, run the commands above with the same Syft version and repeat the scrub. If Syft is upgraded, re-check the expectations below before updating the fixtures; do not edit a literal to match a run until the cause is understood.

## Expected path_infos (design §9.2), through the augmentation

| Package | Scope | Direct / transitive |
|---|---|---|
| pycrypto | runtime | direct |
| left-pad | runtime | direct |
| request | dev | direct |
| node-uuid | runtime | transitive, via express |
| nose | dev | direct |
| six | runtime | direct |
| uuid | dev | transitive, via request |
| moment | runtime | direct |
| express | runtime | direct |

## Expected rank order

`pycrypto, left-pad, request, node-uuid, nose, six, uuid, moment, express`
